Package com.github.crittscott.somegoogly.network

Record Class EyeSettingsPacket

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.github.crittscott.somegoogly.network.EyeSettingsPacket
All Implemented Interfaces:
Payload
public record EyeSettingsPacket(boolean googlyEyesEnabled, BehaviorSettings behaviors) extends Record implements Payload
Server → client: the googlyEyesEnabled master switch and the behavior settings clients run behaviors from. Sent to a joining player and to everyone when either changes. Clients read both afresh every tick, so applying them leaves running eye motion alone.
